 Powerball numbers tonight, Nov. 14? Powerball winning numbers last night
 Chris Sims and Evan Frank, Indianapolis Star Updated Sun, November 15, 2026 at 3:00 AM UTC 4 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. The  Powerball results are in for Saturday night's lottery drawing, worth an estimated $63 million.
 Here are the Powerball winning numbers , where to check your numbers , prize chart values , and more:
 Powerball drawing numbers tonight, Saturday, Nov. 14, 2026: Winning Powerball numbers last night, 11/14/26?
 The winning numbers for Saturday night's drawing were  9, 44, 49, 51, 68,  with a Powerball of  4 . The Power Play was  2x .
 Powerball winner? Lock up your ticket and go hide. What to know if you win the jackpot 
 Powerball Xs and Os game: When is Powerball Xs & Os NFL lottery drawing?
 Don't forget Powerball Xs & Os − the latest lottery offering from Powerball and NFL currently being played in 24 states − holds drawings at 10 p.m. ET every Sunday for a rolling jackpot. Players pick their favorite eight NFL team logos for a chance to win the cash jackpot. Tickets are $5 each. Learn more about Powerball Xs & Os at indystar.com .
 Powerball drawing jackpot, Saturday, November 14, 2026: How much is current Powerball jackpot?
 The Powerball jackpot for Saturday, Nov. 14, 2026, is $63 million with a cash option of $26.3 million, according to  powerball.com .

 Powerball drawing time: When is the next Powerball drawing jackpot?
 The next drawing will be held on Monday, Nov. 16, 2026 . Drawings are held three times per week at approximately 10:59 p.m. ET every Monday, Wednesday, and Saturday.
 How many Powerball numbers do you need to win a prize payout?
 You only need to match one number in Powerball to win a prize. However, that number must be the Powerball worth $4. Visit powerball.com for the entire prize chart.
 What is the Powerball payout on matching 2 lottery numbers?
 Matching two numbers won't win anything in Powerball unless one of the numbers is the Powerball. A ticket matching one of the five numbers and the Powerball is also worth $4. Visit powerball.com for the entire prize chart.
 How much is a Powerball lottery ticket today?
 A single Powerball ticket costs $2. Pay an additional $1 to add the Power Play for a chance to multiply all Powerball winnings except for the jackpot. Players can also add the Double Play for an additional $1 to have a second chance at winning $10 million.
